overall_goal: Prepare, season, and roast the chicken.

goals.description: Prepare the baking tray with aluminum foil.
goals.rationale: The person gets aluminum foil and lines the baking tray with it to prepare for the chicken.

goals.description: Retrieve the chicken and place it on the baking tray.
goals.rationale: The person takes the chicken from the refrigerator, weighs it, and transfers it from its bag onto the prepared baking tray.

goals.description: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
goals.rationale: The person applies salt and pepper to both sides of the chicken, flipping it and wiping their hands as needed.

goals.description: Add oregano, brush the seasoning, and spray with olive oil.
goals.rationale: The person sprinkles oregano, uses a brush to spread the seasoning evenly, and sprays the chicken with olive oil.

goals.description: Place the chicken in the oven to roast.
goals.rationale: The person picks up the baking tray, opens the oven, places the tray inside, and closes the door to begin roasting.
